import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import shutil
from statistics import median
import subprocess
import sys
from types import SimpleNamespace

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BUILD = ROOT / 'build/runtime-v3'
OUT = ROOT / 'benchmarks/results/2026-10-09-runtime-v3.json'
OLD = Path('/tmp/snail-runtime-baseline32-20261009/build/runtime-baseline')
B = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / 'benchmarks/run'), run_name='benchmark_helpers')
A = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / 'benchmarks/ablate'), run_name='ablation_helpers')
REPS = A['REPETITIONS']
TARGETS = ('native', 'wasm')
CHEZ = B['chez_runtime'](SimpleNamespace(snail_only=False, chez=os.environ['CHEZ']))


def freeze():
    B['BUILD'].mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    B['verify_corpus']()
    old = json.loads((OLD / 'results.json').read_text())
    report = {'complete': False, 'old': {'revision': old['revision'], 'builds': old['builds']},
              'new': {'revision': A['checked_text'](['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']),
                      'source_sha256': A['source_state'](),
                      'working_tree_status': A['checked_text'](['git', 'status', '--short']),
                      'builds': []},
              'chez': CHEZ, 'samples': [], 'summaries': [],
              'protocol': 'Build all artifacts first; per workload and target warm old/new/Chez once, then six rounds rotate all three execution positions twice; internal timers exclude compilation/startup; checksum checked each run.',
              'repetitions': REPS,
              'toolchain': {tool: A['checked_text'](cmd) for tool, cmd in {
                  'rustc': ['rustc', '-vV'], 'opt': ['opt', '--version'],
                  'node': [os.environ['NODE'], '--version'],
                  'ld.lld': ['ld.lld', '--version']}.items()},
              'measurement_script': Path(__file__).read_text(),
              'benchmark_driver_sha256': B['fingerprint'](ROOT / 'benchmarks/run'),
              'corpus_manifest_sha256': B['fingerprint'](ROOT / 'benchmarks/corpus/SHA256SUMS')}
    for name in REPS:
        module = B['compile_program'](name)
        B['chez_executable'](name, CHEZ, False)
        for target in TARGETS:
            artifact = B['build_executable'](name, module, target)
            path = BUILD / 'bin' / target / artifact.name
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(artifact, path)
            B['record_artifact'](name, path, module.inputs)
            report['new']['builds'].append({'program': name, 'target': target,
                'path': str(path), 'artifact_sha256': B['fingerprint'](path),
                'artifact_bytes': path.stat().st_size,
                'ir_sha256': B['fingerprint'](module.path),
                'command': B['cargo_command'](target)})
    if report['new']['source_sha256'] != A['source_state']():
        raise RuntimeError('runtime/compiler sources changed while building')
    (BUILD / 'frozen.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    print('FROZEN', BUILD / 'frozen.json', flush=True)


def executable(report, name, target, variant):
    build = next(b for b in report[variant]['builds'] if b['program'] == name and b['target'] == target)
    path = Path(build['path'])
    B['verify_artifact'](name, path)
    if B['fingerprint'](path) != build['artifact_sha256']:
        raise RuntimeError('a frozen executable changed')
    return B['Executable'](variant, target, path, tuple(B['execution_command'](path, target)))


def measure():
    report = json.loads((BUILD / 'frozen.json').read_text())
    OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, count in REPS.items():
        for target in TARGETS:
            group = [executable(report, name, target, v) for v in ('old', 'new')]
            group.append(B['chez_executable'](name, CHEZ, True))
            for item in group:
                B['run_sample'](name, item, count, False)
            rows = []
            for index in range(6):
                offset = index % len(group)
                for position, item in enumerate(group[offset:] + group[:offset]):
                    row = B['run_sample'](name, item, count, False)
                    row.update(comparison_target=target, sample=index + 1, position=position + 1)
                    rows.append(row)
            times = {v: [s['elapsed_ms'] for s in rows if s['implementation'] == v]
                     for v in ('old', 'new', 'chez')}
            medians = {v: median(t) for v, t in times.items()}
            summary = {'program': name, 'target': target, 'median_ms': medians,
                       'range_ms': {v: [min(t), max(t)] for v, t in times.items()},
                       'old_over_new': medians['old'] / medians['new'],
                       'new_over_chez': medians['new'] / medians['chez']}
            report['samples'].extend(rows)
            report['summaries'].append(summary)
            OUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
            print(summary, flush=True)
    report['complete'] = True
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')


(freeze if sys.argv[1] == 'build' else measure)()
